text:
alex: Heads-up: proposing a low-risk 'nudge preview' flow for config flips. quick sketch below.

maria: tl;dr?

alex: operator hits a 'nudge' button -> server runs a preview-run against a sampled slice of prod traffic (eg 0.5-1%) and returns a safety_score + top regression signals. console surfaces result + suggested rollout %.

jordan: how do we compute safety_score?

alex: weighted: err-rate delta, latency p95 delta, and eval regressions from our prompt/metric hooks. default threshold 0.95 to be considered safe.

samir: where does sampling happen — router, edge, or control plane?

alex: at edge routing layer ideally. route sample traffic to a secondary path that applies the new config but mark/charge it as shadow so billing/quotas unaffected. KV cache preserved where possible.

liz: do we have anything like this already?

alex: we have static config preview but not a live-run against sampled traffic. propose POST /config/v2/preview-run that accepts config_id, sample_pct, metrics hooks -> returns run_id and a short safety summary.

jordan: example request:

```
curl -X POST https://api.redwood.internal/config/v2/preview-run \
  -H 'Authorization: Bearer $TOKEN' \
  -d '{"config_id":"cfg_123","sample_pct":1,"metrics":["latency_p95","err_rate"]}'
```

ops-bot: Preview-run feature branch canary deployed to staging :white_check_mark:

maria: who owns adding regression annotations into metrics? @jordan?

jordan: I can add an annotation endpoint on metrics-sink to tag preview-run traffic. Q: retention window for preview data? 1h aggregation should be fine for the UI.

samir: Need rollback playbook: if safety_score < 0.9 auto-mark run as FAIL and surface immediate rollback steps. Also ensure preview-run doesn't trigger throttles or quota exhaustion on downstream.

alex: UX idea: console shows a compact card with green/yellow/red, top-3 diffs, link to raw logs, and an "apply to 10%" button which creates a gradual rollout object.

liz: cost note: preview-run doubles work for the sampled requests; enforce a budget/cap per-run and hard limit sample_pct <= 1% unless special approval.

maria: also need audit trace linking run_id -> operator -> timestamp and the exact config delta.

alex: agreed. I'll draft an API schema + UI mock and open a PR. tagging @jordan @samir for API + infra.

jordan: +1 — will add metrics hooks, ~2 days. :eyes: 

samir: I'll prototype router sampling changes, expect 3-4 days (need to check KV cache interactions).

maria: I'll do the console mock and copy for the flow.

ops-bot: CI: preview-run PR builds green; staging-canary logs: https://ci.redwood/internal/logs/preview-run/1256

alex: thanks all. sync tomorrow 09:00 for handoff and to review the PRs. :shipit:

maria: noted.

jordan: added a TODO to the metrics backlog: preview-run tagging + short retention policy.

samir: adding a short checklist to the playbook: budget check, quota guard, auto-rollback trigger.

alex: perfect — will include in the PR description.

liz: one last thing: can we make the preview-run idempotent so repeated clicks don't spawn duplicate runs? add client-supplied dedupe_key.

alex: good call — will add dedupe_key to the API.

ops-bot: Reminder: staging-canary will be torn down at 02:00 UTC. plan your tests accordingly.
